items.item_text: As a Primary Care Physician with UCLA Health, U can enjoy the close connection of community-focused patient care with the resources and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. We are seeking a
board certified/eligible Internal Medicine physician for our West Washington practice in Culver City.
to learn more about the Internal Medicine Practice.
Utilize your full breadth of clinical skills to treat a diverse patient population
Collaborate with some of the world’s top physicians and researchers at the David Geffen School of Medicine
Work within a highly-innovative practice environment, including Epic Systems
Enjoy an excellent salary, incentive and benefits program (including relocation benefits and CME stipends)
Be valued for your unique background and abilities when you join one of Forbes “Best Employers for Diversity”
Grow your medical career with one of the top ranked hospitals in the entire country!
Must be comfortable working with patients of all ages

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
